role: Base class of every statistic: an id string, a display name, a formatter, an objective criterion, and registration into StatList.
scope_reason: Stats are counted on the server and sent in S37 packets; their identity (equals/hashCode on statId) keys the counter map.

members.name: statId
members.note: The stat's identity is its enum index; the stats compare maps every index to the oracle's statId string (stats_table.h), so each dump checks the ids by name.

members.name: isIndependent
members.note: awardLocallyOnly flag, read only by client GUI code

members.name: numberFormat, decimalFormat, simpleStatType, timeStatType, distanceStatType, field_111202_k
StatBase
members.note: registers the objective criterion; no native counterpart needed

members.name: registerStat
members.note: The registry is the fixed enum and name table built at compile time, in vanilla registration order where the order matters (the achievement list).

members.name: func_150955_j
members.note: The achievement's chat line is text: the integrated server's S02 carries no state, and the playable client builds the same line from its own S37 (play.c); the hud_achieve golden pins the toast.

members.name: hashCode
members.note: HashMap order of the S37 map is replaced by enum order in stats_fill_dirty
